checks.text: A retail sale cannot be credited, and the screen says so: "A retail sale has no account to credit. Use exchange or cash."
The return is recorded against "Retail" and waits for the owner
The approved retail return appears in "Recently decided"

shots.caption: The retail memo opened on the Returns screen
Asking for credit on a retail sale: there is no account to credit
Cash back recorded, waiting for the owner

did: Sold a strip of Napa at the counter to a walk-in buyer (no account). Then, on the Returns screen, found the memo and recorded a return of that strip, asking for cash back. The owner approved it.
